findings: A1: ten H2 sections, not eleven. ## Build plan is deliberately omitted at baseline per generate_instruction.md 2.1; the other ten are present in canonical order.

C7: ## Core features runs past the 2500-char run_rubric slice. G33 reports length and never fails it, and the judged criteria carry their own facts, so the tail costs a diagnostic number rather than reward.

S1: six spec docs, not seven. 06-implementation-plan.md is absent because ## Build plan is not emitted at baseline (generate_instruction.md 2.1), so the doc that feeds it has nothing to feed. Recorded as a warning, not a defect.
S7: NOT-APPLICABLE for the same reason: there is no 06-implementation-plan.md to shape-check.

CMP-011: published host ports removed from the mailpit sidecar. Trials run concurrently on one host and a published port turns a second trial into a bind conflict; the verifier reaches the inbox at mailpit:8025 on the compose network.
CMP-019: restart: unless-stopped removed from every sidecar. The harness owns lifecycle and a restart loop hides a boot failure that should surface.
DEP-004 / HAL-006: git and fonts-liberation removed from the image. No source requires either, and the playwright base already ships the browser fonts.

CMP-020: main carries extra_hosts and ports rather than depends_on alone. C12 in validate_task.py mandates exactly that block and supersedes this row; without extra_hosts the agent's first completion fails on name resolution.

RC-12: J16 sits close to the deterministic line. It is kept in the judged channel because what it grades is whether the failure state reads as a plain apology in the home page footer, which is a rendering judgement rather than the presence of a string.

The prompt declares no numbered registry; the adjudication covers coverage, invention and unpinned literals. 304 items, all cited by at least one grader (G24 two-way PASS). 22 obligations that no in-kit channel can observe were removed from the coverage target and are recorded in the handoff as OPEN-DECISIONS D-H escalations; every one of them remains stated in instruction.md.
META-009 / INT-003: keyword provider order corrected to postgres, mailpit, killbill to match [metadata.services] slot order.

[delivery] is absent, so G2 reports NOT-APPLICABLE (grandfathered). The block requires @sha256 image digests present in environment/, and a digest can only come from a real image build, which this kit never performs. Recorded for the handoff rather than fabricated.

SEC-001 FAIL: PAYMENTS_ADMIN_USER, PAYMENTS_ADMIN_PASSWORD appear in [environment].env, so an admin credential is agent-visible (INV4). instruction.md instructs the agent to read them, so the fix is a naming or scope decision on the payments slot, not a silent deletion. G17 reports the same defect.

Section 8 says no substep carries a `critical` field. stage-6-workflows.md makes workflows.yaml the SOLE owner of `critical` and workflow_lint.py REQUIRES `category` and `weight` on every pytest substep. The stage file and its gate are the operative authority, so `critical` is written there; no test file carries a scoring field of any kind.
